judgements.justification: A's only confidence-4 review (x8VX, 5 h) rated 8 against three confidence-3 6s, and A's AC followed the 6.5 mean without mentioning x8VX.
No reviewer added a new objection after the response period; 4Rfw's and czKb's late edits repeat earlier points or keep acceptance.
B's naZJ and czKb listed almost exactly A's weaknesses yet rated 7, where A's reviewers rated the same faults 6.
No reviewer or AC called the headline claim or title overstated; the 'high accuracy' wording was not raised as a cap.
A's three 6s came at confidence 3 from 7pq7 (unfamiliar with the literature), 4Rfw (1.5 h) and 5o85 (short); the AC read them as a poster, while B committed to 7-8.
